Stock assessments in the dataset

Source: R/stockpile_stocks.R
stockpile_stocks.Rd

List the stock assessments in the dataset. With no arguments, the latest version of every stock assessment is returned.

Usage

stockpile_stocks(
  stock_code = NULL,
  assessment_year = NULL,
  version = "latest",
  as_of = NULL,
  url = stockpile_url(),
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

stock_code

stock codes, for example "sol.27.7d". The default is all stocks.

assessment_year

assessment years. The default is all years.

version

"latest" for the most recent version of each stock assessment, "all" for every version, or version numbers.

as_of

a date or time, to see the dataset as it stood then: only versions submitted up to that time are used. A date means the start of that day.

url

the location of the dataset, see stockpile_url().

refresh

read the table again, even if it has already been read in this session.

Value

A data frame with one row per version:

stock_code, assessment_year, version

identify the version

latest

is this the most recent version of the stock assessment?

case_id

the ICES case number the submissions were made under

stock_key

the key of the stock in the ICES Stock Database, as used by the icesSD package

expert_group

the ICES expert group that assesses the stock

assessment_key

the key of the published assessment in the ICES Stock Assessment Graphs database, as used by the icesSAG package. Missing if the assessment is not published there

submitted

when the most recent submission in the version was made

observed, estimated

does the version have observed data, and model estimates?

indices

the number of survey indices

name, desc

the name and description given by the submitter

quant

what the age column of the values holds, usually "age"

min_age, max_age, plusgroup, min_year, max_year, min_fbar, max_fbar

the ranges of the stock

n_units, n_seasons, n_areas, n_iters

the number of units, seasons, areas and iterations in the submitted object

The ranges are those of the estimated object, or of the observed object where there are no estimates.

See also

stockpile_sources() for the submitted objects behind each version, stockpile_values() for the data.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
stockpile_stocks()
stockpile_stocks("meg.27.7b-k8abd", version = "all")
stockpile_stocks(as_of = "2026-06-01")
} # }
